_note: Quantum ANNEALERS are a separate class: special-purpose samplers for optimisation (Ising / QUBO) problems, NOT universal gate-based QPUs. They have no logical qubits, no error correction and no rQOPS; their qubit count is not comparable with gate-model qubits. Metrics here are samples per second, time-to-target and energy-to-target (per ACCEPTED solution at a stated solution quality and confidence), at the module / system / facility boundaries. Never mix them into rQOPS or logical-qubit comparisons. Profiles as in modalities.json; 'projected' aliases the slow scenario.

today.profile_note: System power: D-Wave Advantage2 data sheet, 'Average power 12.5 kW', rating 208 V 60 A (standard) / 230/400 V 50 Hz 32 A (international), mass 3,900 kg (data sheet read in this audit). Note 208 V x 60 A = 12.5 kVA, so the quoted figure may coincide with the circuit rating rather than a metered average. More than 4,400 qubits (launch coverage). D-Wave says power has stayed at 12.5 kW over six generations (vendor claim).
